candidates.title: D. Pixel city
candidates.prompt: Create an unapproved art-direction study for isometric.tokyo by restyling the attached exact orthographic Shinjuku render. This is a geographic map, not a perspective city illustration. Keep the same square crop, camera angle, relative scale, exact major building positions, roof outlines, stepped tower shapes, relative heights, roads and park boundary. Do not add or remove landmark towers or straighten the real streets. Dense small buildings around the edges must remain dense small buildings, not empty space. The source's repetitive facade marks are artistic placeholders and may become more varied architectural detail. Preserve small canopy locations and open spaces, do not blanket the whole park with invented trees. Give park ground a restrained grass/earth treatment without changing its outline. No title, labels, logos, legend, border, sky, horizon, oversized landmarks, blur, depth of field, photographic noise or new water bodies. Output one complete edge-to-edge square map image, no comparison panels. Art direction D, Pixel city: carefully hand-pixeled architectural cartography, readable crisp pixel clusters, restrained 16-bit simulation-game character, cream streets and roofs, cool blue-gray glazed towers, occasional muted brick and terracotta accents, deep jade vegetation, warm daylight. Detailed but clean and playful. Avoid a uniform window-grid wallpaper; use small architectural pixel rhythms that follow each facade. Strong roof and street separation, subtle short shadows, no thick cartoon outlines. Retain the recognizability of the provided geometry above all.
